payload.title: Router writes relevance_decision_is for lab decisions (P3)
payload.description: Monitoring router delivery path (deliver_reference, record_delivery) writes a relevance_decision_is relation per delivered lab decision in the same persist batch as the Reference + provenance Message, superseding any current relation. Gherkin: Feature: Router-delivered references show the lab suggestion. Scenario: a lab include decision is delivered. Given a monitored item the lab labels include. When the router delivers it. Then the Reference has one current relevance_decision_is relation with the lab output id, label, confidence, and provenance. Re-delivery of the same decision writes nothing; a changed decision supersedes the old relation. Out of scope: procedureTriggers, TRIGGER# rows, runner invoke.
